name: Banh trang Hai An
summary: Bánh tráng Hải An is rice paper the Da Nang Fatherland Front lists at 3 stars, in xã Duy Trinh. No method and no price were printed.
origin: Xã Duy Trinh, on the Fatherland Front’s OCOP account.
howToEat: The account does not say how the paper is eaten. The method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Xã Duy Trinh. No hamlet and no street. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh trang Hai An — rice paper in Duy Trinh
seoDescription: The Da Nang Fatherland Front lists bánh tráng Hải An at 3 stars in xã Duy Trinh. The price is Check on arrival.
